description.value: A boutique-style hotel in Abbotsford, BC, part of the Coast Hotels chain, situated near Highway 1 with a short walk to restaurants, bars, and nightlife. Recently refreshed rooms include free Wi-Fi, mini fridges, and complimentary continental breakfast for all guests. The hotel also features an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre, providing a comfortable rest stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 49m; wall_loops (8 spaces) at 71m; rack (4 spaces) at 71m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was fully fetched and is authoritative. The amenities page confirms free Wi-Fi, a free continental breakfast for all guests, free outdoor parking, an indoor pool, and a fitness facility. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, laundry, e-bike charging, tools) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. The phone number 604.853.1880 is confirmed in the website FAQ, matching the OSM tag.
concerns: OSM community field is listed as 'Chilliwack' but the hotel is located in Abbotsford — possible geographic mis-categorization in the source data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active website and booking system; a legitimate accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through Abbotsford.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Deluxe free continental breakfast included daily for all guests, available in a dedicated breakfast room

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states hotel is 'just a short walk from some of the city's best restaurants, bars and nightlife.'

wow_evidence: indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: Coast Hotels property w/ breakfast + pool, ~$150-190
